items.title: The Equipment List with One Missing Detail

A.question: What is the main lesson of the passage?
A.answer: A checklist should verify that required equipment works, not only that it is present.
A.evidence: The real problem was that the checklist asked if a timer was present, but it did not ask if the timer worked.
A.evidenceJp: 本当の問題は、確認表がタイマーの有無だけを聞き、動くかどうかを確認していなかったことでした。
A.reason: This sentence identifies the missing quality check that caused the failure.

A.question: Why did the student check the other timers before adding extra batteries to every box?
A.answer: To see whether missing batteries were a general problem or only an issue with one timer.
A.evidence: The club leader first planned to add extra batteries to every box. A student checked the other timers and learned that most had fresh batteries and worked well.
A.evidenceJp: 部長は最初、すべての箱に予備の電池を入れようと考えました。ある生徒がほかのタイマーを確認すると、ほとんどは新しい電池が入り正常に動いていました。
A.reason: The check showed that storing extra batteries everywhere would address more than the actual problem.

A.question: Which statement is true according to the passage?
A.answer: The club changed the checklist to say “timer tested and ready” and added a quick test before packing.
A.evidence: The club changed one line to “timer tested and ready” and added a quick test before packing.
A.evidenceJp: そこで一行を「タイマーは動作確認済みで使用可能」に変え、箱に入れる前に短い確認を加えました。
A.reason: This is the final process change described.

A.question: Why were extra batteries in every box unnecessary?
A.answer: Most timers already had fresh batteries and worked; the important step was testing each timer before packing.
A.evidence: A student checked the other timers and learned that most had fresh batteries and worked well.
A.evidenceJp: ある生徒がほかのタイマーを確認すると、ほとんどは新しい電池が入り正常に動いていました。
A.reason: The evidence shows the failure was not a widespread shortage of batteries.

A.question: What four items did the original checklist require?
A.answer: Cups, string, tape, and a timer.
A.evidence: A checklist said that every box needed cups, string, tape, and a timer.
A.evidenceJp: 確認表には、各箱にコップ、ひも、テープ、タイマーが必要だと書かれていました。
A.reason: The four required items are listed directly.

B.question: In “one group could not begin because its timer had no battery,” what does “its” refer to?
B.evidence: On the event morning, one group could not begin because its timer had no battery.
B.evidenceJp: 行事の朝、一つのグループはタイマーに電池がなく、実験を始められませんでした。
B.reason: The timer belonged to the box being used by that group.

B.question: Complete the summary: The old checklist confirmed that a timer was there, but the new process also checked whether it ____.
B.answer: worked and was ready to use
B.evidence: The club changed one line to “timer tested and ready” and added a quick test before packing.
B.evidenceJp: そこで一行を「タイマーは動作確認済みで使用可能」に変え、箱に入れる前に短い確認を加えました。
B.reason: The new wording adds a condition check instead of only a presence check.

B.question: Complete the checklist phrase introduced by the club: “timer ____.”
B.evidence: The club changed one line to “timer tested and ready” and added a quick test before packing.
B.evidenceJp: そこで一行を「タイマーは動作確認済みで使用可能」に変え、箱に入れる前に短い確認を加えました。
B.reason: The new checklist wording is quoted in the passage.

B.question: Where would this sentence fit best: “That meant the checklist was measuring presence, not readiness.”
B.answer: After the sentence explaining that the checklist did not ask whether the timer worked.
B.evidence: The real problem was that the checklist asked if a timer was present, but it did not ask if the timer worked. The club changed one line to “timer tested and ready” and added a quick test before packing.
B.evidenceJp: 本当の問題は、確認表がタイマーの有無だけを聞き、動くかどうかを確認していなかったことでした。そこで一行を「タイマーは動作確認済みで使用可能」に変え、箱に入れる前に短い確認を加えました。
B.reason: The inserted sentence restates the diagnosis before the improved checklist appears.

B.question: What would be a better checklist item for another tool, such as a flashlight?
B.answer: A line that confirms the flashlight was tested and ready, not only that it was packed.
B.evidence: The real problem was that the checklist asked if a timer was present, but it did not ask if the timer worked.
B.evidenceJp: 本当の問題は、確認表がタイマーの有無だけを聞き、動くかどうかを確認していなかったことでした。
B.reason: The lesson applies the same distinction between presence and working condition to other equipment.
